greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, sihawukele. Kristu, sihawukele. Nkosi, sihawukele.
psalm_response: Phakamisani iintloko zenu, kuba intlawulelo yenu isondele.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntwana encinane, esandula ukufunda indlela yokusebenzisa isixhobo esitsha, okanye indlela yokwakha into enentsingiselo kwikhompyutha yakhe. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayenalo elo nqanaba lokufuna ukwazi. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukujonga iinqwelo-moya, owayephupha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi. Kodwa phakathi kobo bukrelekrele, kwakukho intliziyo elula, enothando, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukunika ngaphandle kokuthandabuza.

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane usibonisa umbono onamandla: 'Isithunywa saphakamisa ilitye elinjengelitye elikhulu lokusila, saliphosa elwandle.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Iphoswe elwandle. Le yinkcazo yento edlulayo, into engasayi kuphinda ifumaneke. Kodwa uYohane akapheleli apho. Uva ilizwi elikhulu ezulwini lisithi: 'Alleluia! Usindiso, uzuko, namandla ngakaThixo wethu.' Le yile nto uBen ayifumanayo ngoku. Uphambi kukaThixo, apho akusekho zintlungu, akusekho zifo, apho 'i-con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngesikhathi esinzima. Uthi: 'Kuba le yimihla yezohlwayo.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Imihla yezohlwayo. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa intlungu ikubambile, xa usizi luthatha indawo yovuyo, uvakalelwa kukuba uvalelwe entolongweni yosizi. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo, ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, intliziyo yenu ikhumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen wayesemncumile, ehleka, kwaye esenza amaphupha akhe abe yinyani. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho nibuzayo ukuba kutheni, kwaye kutheni ngoku. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukususa elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu. UBen akazange agule ngenxa yokuba kukho into eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga. Akukho nto niyiphosileyo. Iziphithiphithi zeli hlabathi, izifo, kunye neentlungu, zizinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye uBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayenothando olungagungqiyo kuni, kwaye uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya.

UYesu uthi: 'Phakamisani iintloko zenu kuba intlawulelo yenu isondele.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Phakamisani iintloko. Oku akuthethi ukuba asinakuphulukana nemizimba yethu. Kuthetha ukuba phambi kukaThixo, akukho nto ilahlekileyo. Yonke into oyithandayo, yonke into oyinikileyo, yonke into oyikhumbulayo ngoBen, igcinwe ngokupheleleyo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

Alan noThao, nina bafazi namadoda abathandayo uBen, nina Ryan, mfowethu kaBen, hlalani neli themba. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci, xa wayesadlala neebhaluni zakhe phambi kwe-fireplace.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente yoThando. Nangona ndingakwazi ukukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente yoBomi, ndiyakucela ukuba uze entliziyweni yam ngomoya wakho. Ndiyakwamkela, ndiyakumanya nawe; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndohlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Makube nathi usikelelo lukaThixo uSomandla, uYise, uNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abazilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona esinye isithunywa sisihla ezulwini, sinamandla amakhulu, umhlaba wakhanya ngenxa yobungangamsha baso. Sadanduluka ngelizwi elikhulu: 'Iwele, iwele iBhabheli enkulu. Ibe yindawo yokuhlala iidemon. Ibe yindlu yayo yonke imimoya engcolileyo, indlu yayo yonke intaka engcolileyo, indlu yayo yonke inyamakazi engcolileyo nenyanyekayo.' Isithunywa esinamandla saphakamisa ilitye elinjengelitye elikhulu lokusila, saliphosa elwandle, sathi: 'Ngamandla anjalo iBhabheli, isixeko esikhulu, siya kuwiswa, kwaye asisayi kuphinda sifumaneke. Akukho mculo weehaphu okanye wemigubhu, wemibhobho okanye wemilomolo, oya kuphinda uvakale kuwe kwakhona. Akukho mfundi woqeqesho oya kuphinda afumaneke kuwe. Akukho sandi selitye lokusila esiya kuphinda sivakale kuwe. Akukho kukhanya kwesibane esiya kuphinda sibonwe kuwe. Akukho lizwi lomkhwenyana okanye lomtshakazi eliya kuphinda livakale kuwe. Kuba abathengisi bakho bebengabakhulu behlabathi, kwaye zonke iintlanga zilahlekiswe yimilingo yakho.' Emva koku ndeva ilizwi elinjengelilizwi elikhulu lesihlwele esikhulu ezulwini, sisithi: 'Alleluia! Usindiso, uzuko, namandla ngakaThixo wethu, kuba inyaniso nobulungisa zizigwebo zakhe. Ugwebe isifebe esikhulu esonakalise umhlaba ngobufebe baso. Uphindisele igazi labakhonzi bakhe kuso.' Baphinda okwesibini: 'Alleluia! Umsi uya kunyuka usuka kuso ngonaphakade kanaphakade.' Emva koko isithunywa sathi kum: 'Bhala oku: Banoyolo abo babiziweyo kwisidlo somtshato seMvana.'

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: 'Xa nibona iYerusalem irhangqwe yimikhosi, yazini ukuba intshabalalo yayo isondele. Ke abo baseYuda mababalekele ezintabeni. Abo baphakathi kwesixeko mabaphume kuso, kwaye abo baseemaphandleni mabangangeni esixekweni, kuba le yimihla yezohlwayo apho zonke izibhalo ziya kuzaliseka. Yeha abafazi abamithiyo nabanyisayo kule mihla, kuba intlekele enkulu iya kuza emhlabeni kunye nesigwebo somsindo phezu kwesi sizwe. Baya kuwa ngomkhonto kwaye bathatyathwe njengamabanjwa kuzo zonke iintlanga; kwaye iYerusalem iya kuxhatshazwa ziintlanga de ixesha leentlanga lizaliseke. Kuya kubakho imiqondiso elangeni, enyangeni, nasezinkwenkwezini, kwaye emhlabeni iintlanga ziya kuba sekuphithizeleni, zixakekile kukugquma kolwandle namaza. Abantu baya kufa kukoyika belindele okuzayo ehlabathini, kuba amandla ezulu aya kuxhuzulwa. Kwaye ke baya kumbona uNyana woMntu esiza efini ngamandla nangozuko olukhulu. Kodwa xa le miqondiso iqala ukwenzeka, yimani nime nkqo, niphakamise iintloko zenu, kuba intlawulelo yenu isondele.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
